events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary Monty Python and Fawlty Towers star, John Cleese, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy
angles.copy: He's not the Messiah, he's a very naughty boy! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy genius, John Cleese.

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic double album, officially titled "The Beatles" but known as the "White Album," was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, the 'White Album'. Which track is still on heavy rotation for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost one of the greatest showmen of all time. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to rock.

events.title: The Beatles' "Rubber Soul" anniversary
events.blurb: The groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" by The Beatles was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Classic
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles went 'Norwegian Wood' with the release of 'Rubber Soul'. A true classic.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world mourned the tragic loss of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true visionary. John Lennon's music and message of peace resonate as strongly as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The iconic 'Starman' David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: The Thin White Duke would have turned 80 today. Forever a legend, David Bowie's influence is still out of this world.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: A true icon who changed music forever. The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Pagey's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro of the riff, Led Zeppelin's very own Jimmy Page.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The legendary rock and pop singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Rod's Birthday
angles.copy: From Faces to solo stardom, Sir Rod Stewart is 82 today. Still rocking after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: One step beyond, it's Suggs' 66th birthday! The Madness frontman still brings the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The English singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like "Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)," celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the voice behind those iconic 80s hits, Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon and businesswoman, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly's Birthday
angles.copy: She's always working 9 to 5, but today it's all about Dolly Parton as she turns 81. A true superstar.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter, Gary Barlow, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: From boyband heartthrob to national treasure, Gary Barlow turns 56 today.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Get out of my dreams, get into my car! Or just wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first ceremony
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989, honouring pioneers like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock Hall History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty gathered for the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction.

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: It's Mark Owen's 55th birthday today! Still bringing the charm to Take That and his solo work.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the roof for their unforgettable final live performance. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The Grammy-winning musician, singer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Against All Odds, Phil Collins turns 76 today! A true drumming and vocal legend.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: The multi-talented singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: JT Birthday
angles.copy: Bringing SexyBack for 46 years! Happy birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved English actor, Sir David Jason, known for iconic roles like Del Boy and Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Del Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Lovely jubbly! Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: This day marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash in 1959 that claimed the lives of rock and roll stars Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Music Died Tribute
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, rock and roll lost three of its brightest stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: The pop icon Rick Astley, famous for "Never Gonna Give You Up," celebrates his 61st birthday.

angles.name: Rick Astley Birthday
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and we're never gonna forget his hits! Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: The reggae legend Bob Marley would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Bob Marley Tribute
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Bob Marley would have turned 82 today, his music still uniting the world.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: The acclaimed singer-songwriter Carole King, known for "Tapestry" and countless hits, celebrates her 85th birthday.

angles.name: Carole King Birthday
angles.copy: You've Got A Friend in Carole King, who turns 85 today! A true songwriting legend.
